ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino acid deamination by surface Geotrichum/Mucor, light due to short 30-40d age

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and skatole from pasture-derived raw milk plus rind coryneforms

bitter.reason: hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis, moderated by brine salt

blue_moldy.reason: low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from adventitious rind Penicillium, little interior diffusion

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine on heating, moderate due to low residual sugar

buttery.reason: diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism retained in young pressed curd

cheesy_sweaty.reason: butanoic/hexanoic acids from raw-milk lipase plus starter lipolysis, moderate in 40d age

creaminess.reason: limited fat-coating and calcium-paracasein lubrication due to part-skim 29% fat paste

crumbliness.reason: pressed uncooked curd with small eyes fractures but retains elastic paracasein network

firmness.reason: 56.8% dry matter pressed texture with intact casein, firm-supple not hard

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by lactobacilli, low

fruity.reason: ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterase esterification of free fatty acids with yeast ethanol

goaty.reason: cow milk lacks caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched acids

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylpropanal from leucine/valine Strecker degradation in alpine raw milk

melt.reason: pH ~5.5 demineralized paracasein flows on heating, not excessively cross-linked

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/geosmin from rind Mucor/Geotrichum linoleic acid oxidation in humid cellar

oil_off.reason: moderate fat-in-casein emulsion stability gives little free oil on heating

smoky.reason: no smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol formation in make

sour_vinegar.reason: lactic plus low acetic acid from mesophilic raw-milk starters, pH ~5.5 retains sourness

stretch.reason: non-pasta-filata rennet gel with no hot-water alignment, flows but does not string

sulfur_cooked.reason: uncooked curd with minimal whey-protein denaturation and low methional/H2S

sweet.reason: trace lactose/galactose plus sweet amino acids proline/alanine, mostly fermented away

umami.reason: free glutamate from rennet/plasmin proteolysis during 1-2 month ripening
